conviction_note: Nothing found that decides this print: the reported quarter will very likely land inside a guide the company set in July (revenue consensus $322.4m sits just under the $323-326m guide), the cat environment read from peers is mixed (Hippo benign, Allstate heavy), and the stock trades on the FY guide and the Q4 positive-EBITDA promise, which an Investor Day on 2026-11-17 may partly hold back; a crowded, rising short (15% of shares, 9.7 days) against a +10.6 put skew and three straight beats sold leaves p_up at 51 on a ~14% absolute move, so the scaled number (+0.28) and the findings' sum (+0.6) are both near zero and agree in sign.

positioning_check: Short interest (Equibles, FINRA settlements): 11,625,163 shares at 2026-10-15 (~15.0% of 77.4m shares outstanding; higher as % of float), 9.65 days to cover; 11,383,738 at 09-30 (9.23 d); 10,850,111 at 09-15 (11.94 d); 10,177,727 at 08-31 (10.83 d) - rising for four settlements in a row (https://equibles.com/stocks/lmnd/short-interest, read 2026-11-04). findings.finding: Homeowners peer Hippo reported Q3 2026 on 2026-10-29 with a catastrophe loss ratio of 6.5% of earned premium (YTD 6.0%), cut its full-year cat load assumption from 10% to 8%, and raised FY adjusted net income guidance to $77-80m from $62-70m - evidence that Q3 2026 homeowners weather was normal-to-benign for a personal-lines insurtech, which bears on Lemonade's gross loss ratio (Q2 2026: 60%, of which cat 3 points; Q3 2025 baseline in the letter not stated).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Lemonade's gross loss ratio improvement (67% -> 60% YoY in Q2 2026) did not save the Q2 print, which fell 23.7% on a held guide; loss ratio is a supporting line, not the line this stock has traded on in 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer print dated after Lemonade last spoke (2026-07-29); if the market had read it across, LMND would not have drifted -4% over 20 days into the print with downside skew bid. But it is a proxy: Hippo's book (homeowners, different states) is not Lemonade's mix of renters, home, pet, car and life.
findings.independence: Partly contradicted by Allstate's Q3 2026 cat total (next finding), filed separately. Also https://www.reinsurancene.ws/hippos-gwp-rises-60-for-q326/ (same Hippo release, not independent).

findings.finding: Allstate's monthly releases put Q3 2026 pre-tax catastrophe losses at $1.65bn (July $682m, August $748m, September $220m), nearly three times the $558m of Q3 2025 - a heavier severe-convective-storm quarter for personal property than a year ago, which cuts against a clean Lemonade Home loss ratio if its Texas/Midwest exposure was hit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No Lemonade print in the baseline turned on cat losses; the 2026 reactions (-6.2%, -14.9%, -23.7%) turned on guidance and the profitability timeline.
findings.why_not_priced: Industry-wide public data; the transmission to Lemonade is unconfirmed by the company. Lemonade's quota share was cut to ~18% from July 1 and named-storm cover added, so more of any cat now sits on its own net result. A proxy; sized small.
findings.independence: https://www.artemis.bm/news/allstate-reports-220m-september-pre-tax-cat-losses-taking-aggregate-year-to-3-37bn/ (same Allstate numbers, 2026-10-16). Points the other way from the Hippo finding; the two together roughly offset.

findings.finding: The Q3 2026 guide already tells the market the quarter will be worse sequentially on profit: adjusted EBITDA guided at ($23)-($20)m against Q2's actual ($18.7)m, because 'growth spend [will] increase sequentially in Q3 as we seek to increase investment behind Car', with Q4 implied at ~+$8m; a reported-quarter EBITDA inside that range is a pre-announced item.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat revenue ($294.4m vs $290.9m) and improved EBITDA YoY, and fell 23.7% because FY guidance was held rather than raised (https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/07/29/why-lemonade-stock-is-crashing-today/).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: it is the company's own guide. Filed so the judges see that the reported quarter carries little surprise by design; what is not priced is whether Q4 positive EBITDA is reaffirmed and whether FY IFP is raised, and nothing found settles either.
findings.independence: https://www.benzinga.com/quote/LMND/earnings-forecasts (Q3 revenue consensus $322.4m sits at the guide, i.e. the street follows the guide).

findings.finding: Lemonade holds an Investor Day in New York on 2026-11-17, twelve days after this print; long-term targets and a 2027 framework are more likely to be saved for that event than given on 2026-11-05, so the Q3 release may again 'hold' rather than raise the forward picture - the exact pattern the Q2 print was sold for.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: FY IFP and EBITDA guide essentially held (FY IFP up only from $1,625-1,630m to $1,632-1,639m), stock -23.7%. Q3 2025: raised outlook, stock +34.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: The date is public but the inference that it mutes the Q3 guide is not in any preview found; if it were priced the event straddle would be smaller than the name's own 14.85% median reaction, and it is close to it (13.31%). An inference, sized small; it could equally act as a reason holders wait rather than sell.
findings.independence: Same document as the guide finding; https://quartr.com/events/lemonade-inc-lmnd-q2-2026_3sNSjGpq describes Q2 as reiterating IFP and EBITDA guidance.

findings.finding: Short interest has risen four settlements in a row to 11.63m shares at 2026-10-15 (~15% of shares outstanding, 9.65 days to cover), up from 10.18m at 2026-08-31, so a clean beat with a firmed Q4 EBITDA turn meets a crowded short that needs about two weeks of volume to cover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (+34.2%) and Q2 2025 (+29.5%) were up-moves on raised outlooks with high short interest (MarketBeat cited 25.75% of float in Oct 2025); in 2026 the shorts have won three prints running.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public, and the put skew (+10.6) says the market leans the shorts' way; the squeeze is asymmetric to a positive surprise and is not in the straddle's sign. Sized below the skew's statement because the option market is paying for the other tail.
findings.independence: https://equibles.com/stocks/lmnd/short-volume (41-49% daily short-sale volume Oct 26-28, a flow, not a position); MarketBeat mid-May 17.05% of float (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/LMND/short-interest/).

findings.finding: Revenue bar sits below the guide: Benzinga's Q3 revenue consensus is $322.4m against the company's $323-326m range, and Lemonade beat revenue in Q2 2026 ($294.4m vs $290.9m consensus) after guiding it; reduced quota share (~20% to ~18% from July 1) mechanically lifts retained premium and revenue, so a 1-2% revenue beat is the likely print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats were sold in Q1 2026 (-14.9%) and Q2 2026 (-23.7%, beat $294.4m vs $290.9m); this name has not paid for a revenue beat in 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it lands inside the company's own guide and the reaction function sells this line. Filed small for completeness.

findings.finding: The stock traded at ~$54.6 on 2026-09-03/04 (prices on executives' tax-withholding Form 4 sales) and is $44.80 into the print, an ~18% fall in two months with no company 8-K, offering or guidance change found to explain it (the only 8-K since July is a 2026-10-15 8-K/A on CFO succession pay).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not a reported line; 2026 prints followed run-downs and still fell.
findings.why_not_priced: An unexplained drawdown is not evidence of over-reaction; it may be priced disappointment. Filed at zero so the judges see the lowered entry level.
findings.independence: EDGAR filing list for CIK 0001691421 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001691421&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40) shows no 8-K between 2026-07-29 and 2026-10-15.

findings.finding: Progressive's September 2026 combined ratio was 90.0 (YTD 87.5) with policies in force up ~6-8% in auto, i.e. US personal auto remained profitable in Q3 2026, a supportive backdrop for Lemonade Car's loss ratio (61% in Q2 2026 vs 74% in Q1) though trade press flagged it as Progressive's weakest month of 2026, a sign of softening price competition for Car's growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Car loss ratio improvement was in the Q2 letter and did not prevent the -23.7% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Broad industry series, public; transmission to a ~$239m-IFP Car book (~17% of IFP) is unconfirmed by Lemonade. A proxy, sized small, net of the 83% of IFP that is not Car.

findings.finding: Hurricane Isaias, the first hurricane of the 2026 season, was forecast to make Category 1-2 landfall on the northern Gulf Coast (Mississippi to Florida Panhandle) on 2026-10-09/10 with industry insured loss estimates of $3-5bn; it falls in Q4 and can only reach this print through the Q4 adjusted-EBITDA guide (~+$8m implied), and Lemonade's home footprint on that coast is unverified, while its new reinsurance now covers named storms.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior Lemonade print turned on a named storm in the baseline window.
findings.why_not_priced: Public event, but whether it dents a Q4 target that is only ~$8m wide is not public until management speaks; a small Q4 cat charge could flip the 'positive EBITDA in Q4' promise, which is the line the stock has traded on. Proxy and unverified exposure, sized small.

findings.why_not_priced: Immaterial size; filed at zero as a non-result on the insider angle.

baseline_tension: What I found is roughly balanced and does not overturn the +10.6 put skew or the -4.3% 20-day drift; the one asymmetric item, a crowded and rising short, cuts against the skew, so p_up sits only a point above 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction; this name sold its Q1 and Q2 revenue beats): revenue-beat finding cut from +0.5 to +0.2, and p_up moved from 52 to 51.
Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0): the ~18% fall since early September cut from +0.5 to 0.0, kept filed.
Lesson 7 (a sign against a strong skew needs a reason or a smaller size): short-interest squeeze finding cut from +1.0 to +0.8; the reason kept is the squeeze mechanism on a 9.7-day-to-cover short.

Lessons 2, 6 and 9 left the rest standing: the bar is the company guide plus Benzinga, the Investor Day is in outside_window as well as filed as a guidance inference, and the Car proxy was already sized net of the 83% of IFP that is not Car.
